The `flaky` service restarts because it is designed to fail. Its command is `sh -c "echo starting; echo 'fatal: missing DATABASE_URL' >&2; exit 3"`, so it prints a message and exits with code 3 every time. With `restart: always`, Docker restarts it each time it exits.

The service never sets `DATABASE_URL`. It only sets `DATABASE_URL_HINT: "set DATABASE_URL"`, which is a string and not the variable the script checks. To stop the loop, add `DATABASE_URL` under `environment` with a real value, or remove the failing `exit 3` from the command.

Separately, `API_SECRET: "s3cr3t-value"` is hardcoded in the compose file. If this file is committed, move the secret into a `.env` file or your shell environment.

I didn't change any files.
